component.name: linux-regedit
注册表编辑器（Linux 配置浏览）
component.summary: Windows-regedit-style browser for Linux configuration files
以 Windows 注册表编辑器风格浏览 Linux 系统配置

description.p: A playful yet carefully engineered configuration browser: /etc, ~/.config and /boot are presented with the classic regedit tree and value columns. Content sniffing supports INI, TOML, flat key-value, systemd units, keyword files, JSON, XML and apt configuration.
一个“表层整活、内核认真”的配置浏览器：把 /etc、~/.config、/boot 伪装成 Windows 注册表来浏览。支持 INI、TOML、扁平键值、systemd、关键字文件、 JSON、XML 与 apt 配置的内容嗅探与解析。
